SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: What on earth did you want to ask me?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'm sure you would know, since you took the time to listen to me after all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Isn't that a given?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You sure are direct, aren't you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Since I am accompanying you on such a senseless errand, just spare me the sarcasm.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Geez... whatever, I'll get straight to the point.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'll ask you once more. Tell me the problems you're having.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: It's not like I need to tell you anything.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Why are you still saying that? I'm worried about you!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: What a troublesome person... It'll certainly be regrettable if I were to tell you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Why is it regrettable? Who will regret it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: It'll be me. I'm regretting that I mentioned this in the first place.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Hmm, it seems like you're being philosophical here...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Really? My speech and conduct are supposed to be easily understood, are they not?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What are you saying?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...I have chosen the most suitable answer to make you satisfied.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Aren't you trying really hard to sound sophisticated?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Hmm... that might be the case. But it doesn't really matter anyway, since you wouldn't understand.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: So, won't you give up already?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No. I'm just getting started.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...*sigh*, I get your enthusiasm already.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: So you finally understand.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Yes, it is simply reckless passion.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'm totally being serious! I'm not being reckless!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: If you don't retain your composure, it is the same. I said that I understood your enthusiasm, did I not?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: However, this has nothing to do with you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: How does this have nothing to do with me if it's happening around me?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: A fine argument.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: But if you end up getting involved in everything, won't you be up to your neck in work?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Of course, there are priorities I need to handle, which is why I'm dealing with you first.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: It can't have nothing to do with me if it concerns you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...Is it because of your kindness?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Eh? What did you just say? I couldn't quite hear it...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...It matters not. Anyways, I ought to thank you since you're doing this for my sake.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I see... then, tell me...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: But, I don't want to.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Why is that?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Don't say it so coldly.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I mean it when I say that it has nothing to do with you. Isn't it because of your arrogance that you're feeling the coldness of my words?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Why do you think that?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Because you're just forcing your own feelings upon others?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: How can I not worry if you start talking about something like that?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Also, it's only a waste of time if we were to continue on this philosophical topic.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Let's change the topic.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: It'll certainly cause trouble for you if I were to tell you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Why would it cause trouble for me?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Because it'll hurt you too.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: If that's the case, wouldn't not telling me anything cause me pain as well?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Aren't you just mindlessly getting yourself into trouble?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: It's not like that, but it's really troubling.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Whether it's troubling or not isn't up to you to decide, it's for me to decide.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...True, what you have said is correct.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: But since you already know about it, then why can't you understand that I don't wish to cause harm to you as well?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: T-That's...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: You've raised a bunch of one-sided theories, but those are more like irrational thoughts than theories.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: B-But... isn't what's really important how one thinks, and not how one expresses himself?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Needless protesting... that's what best describes you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Good grief... you just don't give up, do you. However, that's exactly the reason why I'm not telling you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Getting in the way... I didn't think of it like that way.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Hmph, I knew you would say that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: That's why you're being involved in various situations without realizing you're losing something.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Losing something, and what's that?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: You're indeed a good person for not realizing it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: That's right, senpai is a good person, so if I speak up you'll surely...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: No, I can even say definitely. You'll definitely get involved.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Are you saying I shouldn't?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Yes, if you don't understand the need to be reserved, then you truly are a selfish man.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Yeah, that's because I'm stubbornly nice.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'm called nice because I persevere in my actions. That's why your convenience is irrelevant!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Wha...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ....Yes, that's right, that's why I'm asking you to let me involve myself this time, too.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...Hmph. How many sighs do I have to make? Honestly, you're so...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Can't I be a good person?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: There are times where a good person would be a bad one, however...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: However? Aren't you the same?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Exactly, I wish this person could quickly realize that his good intentions are only a hindrance.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I don't get it...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: How thickheaded... No, that's why I don't need this good person.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: My, how I wish I could quickly end this torment with such a person.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I don't know what trouble you have exactly, but I can roughly feel how much you don't want to tell me about it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: But I'm not easily convinced. It's the same no matter how you hold me down.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: This is not about others, but you! How could I treat it like it's some stranger?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I wish you could tell me even if you were to feel irritated.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Could you please stop finding excuses to refuse me?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Although I don't know what else to say to request from you, but please, Kuroneko... Alright?
